name: send_email
description: Send an email on the owner's behalf. The owner approves every email before it goes out.

body.description: Plain-text body, signed with the owner's name.

name: wait_for_reply
description: Wait for the company to answer. Returns any replies that arrive, or tells you nobody answered.

max_days.description: The longest to wait, in days (1 to 14). If nothing arrives by then, it returns so you can follow up.

name: ask_owner
description: Ask the owner a question. Use this only when you truly need information or a decision from them: every question costs them time.

name: note
description: Rewrite your working notes for this case: what you have tried, what the company said, and what you plan next. They replace your previous notes, are shown to you at every step, and your owner can read them. Keep them short.

text.description: Your full notes, replacing the old ones.

name: close_case
description: Close the case and report to the owner. Call this once, at the end.

status.description: "done" only if the company confirmed in writing; "failed" if it can't be done; "needs_owner" if the owner must act themselves.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences for the owner about what happened and what, if anything, they need to do.

evidence.description: For "done", quote the company's written confirmation exactly. Otherwise leave empty.

check_after_days.description: For "done": in how many days your owner could see for themselves that it worked, such as after the next bill or when the refund should have arrived (3 to 90). Use 0 otherwise.

check_question.description: For "done": the one yes/no question to ask your owner on that day, such as "Did the charge stop?". Otherwise leave empty.
